summary: Published drafters that read the target's hidden states (EAGLE-3) or draft a block per pass (DFlash, DSpark): one Core description of every published format with one tap convention, and device glue for catch-up, block input, draft-vocabulary mapping and confidence truncation in the device speculative round
implementation_scope: Core's crit_core.model.drafters reads speculators (eagle3, peagle, dflash, dflash2, dspark), native EAGLE-3, native DFlash and native DSpark configs into one Drafter with taps as residual-stream indices. A Python reference and CUDA reference kernels supply EAGLE-3 catch-up columns from the round's packed result and settled count, block-drafter input, d2t mapping, draft-law scatter to the target vocabulary and confidence truncation. flash-prefill-attention's causal = false runs a block drafter's non-causal block. Drafter arithmetic and the target's tap writes are engine supplied.

agent_guidance.use_when: A drafter trained for the target is published (speculators, EAGLE-3, DFlash or DSpark checkpoints) and the target has no built-in draft head or its head accepts less
agent_guidance.avoid_when: No published drafter matches the target (crit never trains one), the drafter needs another model family's state, or the measured tap writes and drafter passes cost more than the tokens they add
provides: One Drafter description from every published config format, with taps as residual-stream indices and EAGLE-3's default taps
EAGLE-3 catch-up columns (taps of column c with the c-th emitted token) over a fixed width from the device's settled count
Block-drafter input [anchor, mask...] at frontier positions, and non-causal block attention through flash-prefill-attention
Draft-vocabulary to target mapping through d2t, and draft-law scatter for rejection sampling
Confidence truncation that stops a round at the first unlikely draft without a narrower graph
engine_supplies: The drafter's arithmetic as published (fc over fused taps, decoder layer, head; block layers with context injection)
Tap writes in the target's verify and prefill, and the drafter's own KV
Argmax over the drafter's head (for example draft-vocabulary-subset's gather-argmax)
The confidence threshold, chosen on general text
preserve: Taps from Core's reader, never a format's own convention re-derived
EAGLE-3 alignment: taps at position p with the token at p + 1
Catch-up from the count Core's truncation has settled
d2t mapping before verification; truncated drafts that no prediction matches
adapt: Fusing tap writes into the target's residual adds
The drafter's precision and its draft width up to the publisher's
The confidence source (a confidence head or the drafter's top probability)

code_files.purpose: Host reference: catch-up columns, block input and drafts, d2t mapping, law scatter and confidence truncation
Launch interfaces over device-speculative-round's control block and packed result
Reference CUDA kernels for catch-up, block input, mapping, scatter and truncation

requires.hardware: CUDA C++20 and device-speculative-round's greedy_accept.h; Python 3.11+ for Core's reader and the reference
requires.model: A target with a published hidden-state drafter sharing its tokenizer (or a d2t table into it)
requires.workload: Speculative decoding through the device round, greedy or sampled

contract.input: A drafter config.json and the target's layer count; per round the control block, packed result, d2t, draft-law rows and confidences
contract.output: A Drafter; catch-up tokens and positions, block tokens and positions, mapped drafts, target-vocabulary laws and truncated drafts
contract.ownership: The engine owns every device buffer; kernels borrow them on the caller's stream
contract.failure: Malformed or inconsistent drafter configs raise ConfigError (taps past the target, a block drafter without block size or mask, EAGLE-3 defaults without the target's depth); foreign configs read as None; launches reject null buffers and blocks without a mask slot
contract.core_boundary: crit_core.model.drafters is Core's reader; recon can record its Drafter beside the target's config facts

validation.host: Core's reader on speculators EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark, native EAGLE-3 with default taps, native DFlash and DSpark agreeing on one tap convention, rejected and foreign configs and a drafter directory; the drafting reference's rules
validation.native: Catch-up tokens and positions from the packed result, including after a Core truncation and at the widest width + 1 after a wider round (a narrower round's K + 1 drops its tokens); block input; d2t mapping and law scatter keeping mass; confidence truncation
validation.performance: No drafter arithmetic or speedup is qualified
